text:
drew: Hey team — attached is the latest coop_solution_brief_v3.pdf and the partner-provided SVGs. Need a quick brand + legal check before we publish to marketplace.
emily: Thanks — glancing now. Quick ask: can we use the partner logo on dark backgrounds? They sent two variants but not sure which is primary.
sahil: Partner guidelines: 'use full-color on white or neutral backgrounds; use reversed white when contrast is needed; do not place on busy imagery.' I pasted that from their PDF.
drew: Copy. I'll keep the white-reverse as the fallback. Also they included a customer quote from Acme AI — is that cleared? It looks like a short testimonial.
jordan: I pinged Acme's contact, they confirmed approval over email but no signed release. @legalbot can you confirm if an email ok for marketplace publish?
legalbot: Automated check: email approval is acceptable for marketing use per standard partner POC agreements, but we need the name + title included with the quote. Missing title in the asset. Please obtain title or redact.
emily: Good catch. Quote currently: "Redwood Inference cut our latency in half." No title. I can ask for full attribution, but would prefer to keep it concise.
drew: Can we add alt text for the logos for accessibility? Marketplace requires alt text and an asset description.
sahil: Suggested alt text: "Coop Systems logo (full color)" and "Coop Systems logo (white reversed)". Also add file names: coop_logo_full.svg, coop_logo_reversed.svg in the asset manifest.
jordan: On sizing — the marketplace thumbnail needs a square lockup. Can we get a lockup with the Redwood+Coop logomark side-by-side? Partner only provided a horizontal lockup.
emily: They prefer horizontal. I can create a stacked lockup for the thumbnail, but must confirm with partner before final.
drew: If we make one internally, mark it as "for marketplace thumbnail only" and show for approval.
legalbot: Also flag: partner requested "do not modify logotype" — stacked lockup could be considered modification. Recommend explicit written ok from partner before we create it.
jordan: I'll request explicit approval and ask for title for the quote in same thread.
emily: One more: the PDF has a product architecture diagram with partner IP labels. Partner asked to remove any internal IP markers. They provided a sanitized PNG; need to swap it in.
drew: Uploaded sanitized_artwork.png to the thread.
emily: :eyes: checking the PNG now. Passes quick QA — PNG background is transparent which is great for the marketplace tile.
sahil: Also checking color profiles — export both SVGs with sRGB and optimized paths. I can run a small script to strip metadata if needed.
drew: If we get partner sign-off on stacked lockup + title, we can cut the marketplace listing Wednesday. Timeline ok?
jordan: Asking partner now. I'll follow up in 2 hours and post their reply here.
(2h later)
jordan: Partner replied: title provided — "CTO, Acme AI". They gave written permission to use a stacked lockup "for marketplace badge only". Also attached approved stacked_lockup.png.
emily: Great. I updated the PDF to swap in sanitized diagram, replaced quote with title, and added alt text strings in the asset manifest.
drew: Awesome. Final checklist for release:
- use coop_logo_full.svg on listing hero (white bg)
- use coop_logo_reversed.svg for dark-mode preview
- use stacked_lockup.png for square thumbnail (partner-approved)
- include quote with name + "CTO, Acme AI"
- include alt text entries in manifest
- include sanitized_artwork.png for architecture diagram
sahil: I'll run the svg optimizer and push final assets to S3: s3://redwood-partner-assets/coop/2024-05-29/
legalbot: Confirmed: all legal flags cleared for publishing. Retain partner email thread in compliance folder.
drew: Thanks everyone — publishing in the morning. :rocket:
emily: :thumbsup: will post final proof here after upload.
sahil: Uploaded optimized assets and manifest.json to the bucket. Link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-partner-assets/coop/2024-05-29/manifest.json
drew: Closing loop — marketplace listing scheduled. If anything else, reopen thread.
